error: Position reversed: the Arabic says ʿAbdullāh prayed between the narrator and the other man, not that the narrator stood between ʿAbdullāh and them.

segments_en: Ubayy said: A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a hare he had roasted, and bread. He placed it before the Prophet ﷺ and then said, "I found that it bleeds."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to his Companions:
"It does no harm; eat." And he said to the Bedouin, "Eat."
He said, "I am fasting." He said, "What fast?"
He said, "Fasting three days of the month." He said:
"If you are fasting, then keep to the bright white days: the thirteenth, the fourteenth and the fifteenth."
error: The narrator is named Ubayy (أُبَيّ) in the Arabic. The translation renders it as "My father", which misattributes the report.

segments_en: and Ḥamzah,
the two sons of ʿAbdullāh, from their father,
from the Prophet ﷺ. (Transfer of chain.) And Yaḥyā ibn Yaḥyā and ʿAmr al-Nāqid narrated to us,
and Zuhayr ibn Ḥarb, from Sufyān, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father,
from the Prophet ﷺ. (Transfer of chain.) And ʿAmr al-Nāqid narrated to us,
Yaʿqūb ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us: my father narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ,
from Ibn Shihāb, from Sālim and Ḥamzah,
the two sons of ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar,
from the Prophet ﷺ. (Transfer of chain.) And ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Shuʿayb ibn al-Layth ibn Saʿd narrated to me: my father narrated to me, from my grandfather,
ʿUqayl ibn Khālid narrated to me,
(Transfer of chain.) And Yaḥyā ibn Yaḥyā narrated it to us,
Bishr ibn al-Mufaḍḍal informed us,
from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn
Isḥāq. (Transfer of chain.) And ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Dārimī narrated to me,
Abū al-Yamān informed us: Shuʿayb informed us,
all of them from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father,
from the Prophet ﷺ, concerning ill omen.
Like the hadith of Mālik. None of them mentions, in the hadith of Ibn ʿUmar, 'contagion' and 'bird omens', except Yūnus ibn Yazīd.
error: Segment 18: الْعَدْوَى means 'contagion', not 'the ʿAdawī' (a tribal/person nisba).

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"Do not grant ruqbā and do not grant ʿumrā; whoever is granted something as ruqbā or ʿumrā, it belongs to his heirs."
error: The verbs are passive (أُرْقِبَ/أُعْمِرَ): it is the recipient whose heirs inherit. The translation makes the one who grants the gift the subject, which reverses who inherits.

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ set out from Madinah in Ramadan,
with ten thousand men,
and that was at the end of eight and a half years after his arrival in Madinah.
He and the Muslims with him travelled to Makkah,
he fasting and they fasting, until he reached al-Kadīd, a watering place between ʿUsfān and Qudayd, [where] he broke his fast and they broke their fast.
Az-Zuhrī said: Only the latest, and then the latest, of the commands of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is to be taken.
error: Segment 3 mistranslates 'eight and a half years' as 'the beginning of the eighth year and a half', which changes the date. Segment 6 misrenders 'al-ākhir fal-ākhir' (the latest, then the latest) as 'the latest... then the one after it'.

segments_en: He used to breathe three times while drinking from the vessel, and Anas claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to breathe three times while drinking from the vessel.
error: Wrong subject: the Arabic says Anas himself claimed this (وَزَعَمَ أَنَسٌ). The translation has an unnamed 'he' claiming that Anas said it.

segments_en: And my eyes saw,
when the Prophet ﷺ spoke, and he said:
"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his neighbor,
and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest with his due gift."
He said: What is his due gift, O Messenger of Allah? He said:
"A day and a night, and hospitality is three days,
and whatever is beyond that is charity for him,
and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent."
error: Added clause: 'and my ears heard' is not in the Arabic of segment 2, which only says the eyes saw.

segments_en: [The Prophet ﷺ said] to the two of them when they read the letter of Musaylimah:
"What do the two of you say?"
They said, "We say as he said." He said:
"By Allah, were it not that envoys are not killed, I would have struck off your necks."
error: The Arabic قَرَآ is dual: the two men read Musaylimah's letter. The English says 'he read', which gives the wrong subject.

segments_en: We besieged the fortress of aṭ-Ṭāʾif with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Muʿādh said: I heard my father say "the castle of aṭ-Ṭāʾif" and "the stronghold of aṭ-Ṭāʾif," all of these. Then I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
"Whoever delivers an arrow in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will have a rank [in Paradise]."
And he went on with the hadith. And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:

"Any Muslim man who frees a Muslim man, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will make every bone of the freed man a protection from the Fire for the corresponding bone of the one who freed him. And any woman who frees a Muslim woman, Allah will make every bone of the freed woman a protection from the Fire for the corresponding bone of the one who freed her, on the Day of Resurrection."
error: In the woman's case the roles are reversed. The Arabic makes the bones of the freed woman the protection for the bones of the freer; the translation has the freer's bones protecting the freer.

segments_en: A funeral passed by the two of them; one stood and the other sat. The one who stood said, "By Allah, I know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood." The one who sat said to him, "I know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ [also] sat."
error: The Arabic "ʿalimtu" is first person ("I know"), but the translation renders it as "you know", which changes who is asserting the knowledge.

segments_en: I cut a boy's ear—or my ear was cut. Then Abū Bakr came to us on Hajj, and we gathered to him, and we brought the matter before ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb. ʿUmar said: This [boy] has reached the age for retaliation. Call a cupper for me so that retaliation may be taken from him. When the cupper was called, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
"I gave my maternal aunt a boy as a gift, hoping that she would be blessed in him. I said to her: Do not hand him over to a cupper, nor a goldsmith, nor a butcher."
error: Wrong subject: the Arabic says "I cut" (قَطَعْتُ) a boy's ear, but the translation says a boy's ear was cut, dropping the speaker as the one who did it.

segments_en: That Fāṭimah

wept over the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he died, and she said, "O my father, how near he is to his Lord! O my father, to Jibrīl we announce his death! O my father, whose abode is the Paradise of Firdaws!"
error: The Arabic "مِنْ رَبِّهِ مَا أَدْنَاهُ" means "how near he is to his Lord". The translation adds "who answered the call of his Lord", which is not in the text, and makes "to him" ambiguous.

segments_en: There was a man from the Anṣār who, whenever he was absent from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I was present, I would come to him with what had happened with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; and whenever I was absent from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he was present, he would come to me with what had happened with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
error: The first clause reverses the roles. The Arabic says the narrator would come to the Anṣārī man (أتيته) when the man was absent. The translation has the man coming to the narrator.

segments_en: I came to Syria and prayed two rakʿahs,
then I said, "O Allah, make easy for me a righteous companion."
So I came to some people and sat with them,
and an elderly man came and sat beside me.
I asked, "Who is this?" They said, "Abū al-Dardāʾ."
I said to him, "I asked Allah to make easy for me a righteous companion, and He has made you [one] for me."
He asked, "Where are you from?" I said, "From the people of Kufa."

He said, "Do you not have with you the son of Umm ʿAbd, the keeper of the sandals, the cushion, and the purification vessel? And among you is the one whom Allah protected from Satan upon the tongue of His Prophet ﷺ. And do you not have among you the keeper of the secret of the Prophet ﷺ, which no one else knows?" Then he said, "How does ʿAbdullāh recite {By the night when it covers}?"
So I recited to him: {By the night when it covers, and the day when it appears, and the male and the female.}
He said, "By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught it to me directly from his mouth to mine."
error: Segment 9 adds "He who created" to the recitation; the Arabic reads simply "and the male and the female". This changes the wording of the recited verse, which is the point of the report.

segments_en: When one of us was menstruating,
and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wished to have contact with her,
he would order her to wrap an izār around herself at the height of her menstruation, and then he would have contact with her.
She said, "And which of you can control his desire as the Prophet ﷺ controlled his desire?"
error: The Arabic says 'his desire' (إربه), not 'her desire'; the translation wrongly makes the one controlling desire female.

segments_en: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd, may Allah be pleased with him, said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, which deed is best?" He said:
"Prayer at its proper time."
I said, "Then which?" He said:
"Then dutifulness to parents."
I said, "Then which?" He said:
"Striving in the cause of Allah."
Then I fell silent with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and had I asked for more, he would have given me more.
error: Wrong subject: it is Ibn Masʿūd who fell silent (stopped asking), not the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
